goal: Preserve every existing JANUS+NOISE detection and 69 weak injections by construction; seek new RFI discrimination features without another retrospective audit threshold search.

source.reference: R42A6 code/source-verified R42A5 merged 3168 rows and common V [N,16,128] spectrogram

new_feature_family.name: Alternative-hypothesis background and instrumental common-mode
new_feature_family.source: Same registered original spectrogram V plus frozen candidate path, no labels or truth fields in feature extraction
new_feature_family.data_independence: New transform and feature family, NOT independent instrument/sky observation
new_feature_family.normalization: per-row robust median and MAD floor 0.02, capped normalized values [-30,+30]
new_feature_family.off_path_rule: mask +/-4 bins around frozen JANUS path, leave all other bins
new_feature_family.alternative_trajectories: 16 fixed alternative paths of signed offsets +/-8,+/-16,+/-24,+/-32 with zero or +/-1 channel/epoch slope; compute strongest over first/middle/last epochs. Precommitted before labels.

model.inputs: new 8 independent-transform diagnostic features only, no JANUS/NOISE score or prior morphology features
model.training_rows: Only reference-positive correctly localized signals and reference false-alert negative controls in fit groups 1–6
model.audit: Leave-one-fit-group-out; each fold trains exclusively on five other fit groups
model.ranking: Fixed top 5 shadow-flagged original alerts per held-out fit group. Flag means inspect only, never suppress/reject.
model.selection: No threshold tuning, fit-only model and fixed control-review budget; if data are not discriminative report FAIL.

success.hard_preservation_invariant: For every source candidate and every positive/weak injection original accepted JANUS+NOISE route remains accepted; all reported false alarms remain 51 until actual independent adjudication
success.cv: Report number of control alerts and true injected positive alerts in top-5 shadow review queue per group, plus AUC if both labels
success.external: Only new untouched groups or genuinely independent telescope data can support generalization

pending_new_data: R42A7B new independent source/survey design with original pointing and mutually independent source context; no scientific PASS from prior groups
